Adult representative.25–28cm rail with long fine slightly decurved red bill darker culmen/tip, dull red pink legs; no or vestigial dark eye stripe, less extensive white throat and darker grey underparts lacking brown tinge vs R.indicus. Few/no indistinct undertail bars researched but artificial artwork undertail not reliable, do not label that as demonstrated diagnostic. Europe/N Africa through W/CAsia to NW China, breeding Xinjiang, north populations winter N Africa/SW/SAsia. korejewi eastern range presumed HK form not assigned to art. HK accidental. LC decreasing.

Adult Slaty-breasted Rail Lewinia striata rusty chestnut crown/nape and irregular white/black crossbars upperparts vs black-centred streaks of Rallus; shorter deeper bill pink base/dark culmen, grey underparts pale throat. Juvenile/immature differs. LC increasing globally despite local HK decline.

rangeMap.note: Adult Rallus indicus (Brown-cheeked Rail, HKBWS Eastern Water Rail),23–29cm, long slightly decurved bill dull red base/lower mandible dark culmen/tip, dull pink-red legs. Brown upperparts black feather centres from crown/nape to mantle. Grey blue-grey face/breast/upper belly variably brown washed, dark lores/eye stripe contrasting dull grey supercilium and usually extensive WHITE THROAT. Black-white flank/lower belly bars and black barred white undertail. Monotypic split from R.aquaticus; retain runtime English/Chinese/scientific names. Breeds N Mongolia/E Siberia/NE China/Sakhalin/NJapan; winters NE India/Bangladesh/Myanmar/NThailand/NLaos/ESEChina incl Hainan/Taiwan/Korea/SJapan. HK scarce winter marsh visitor. LC decreasing. World partial native-country overview only not whole-country occupancy, seasonal polygons or complete range.
